d:
The search for Bigfoot leads the team deep into remote wilderness, where strange sounds, unexplained sightings and mysterious clues keep the investigation alive. From tracking possible footprints to examining unusual encounters, every expedition brings new questions about the elusive creature.
Revisit the most memorable moments from three seasons of Expedition Bigfoot as the team follows leads, investigates possible Bigfoot evidence and pushes deeper into the unknown. Will these discoveries bring them closer to finding answers?
